title: Artificial Intelligence Generates Stereotypical Images of Scientists but Can Also Detect Them: A Pilot Study Using the Draw-A-Scientist Test

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating AI-generated images of scientists for stereotypical professional accessories and settings (e.g., lab coats, eyeglasses, indoor environments, symbols of research) using both human scoring and a Vision Language Model (gpt-4.1-mini) based on the Draw-A-Scientist Checklist (DAST-C).

Analyzing the frequency of male gender representation in AI-generated images of scientists by applying the Draw-A-Scientist Checklist (DAST-C) to measure the amplification of male-dominated STEM stereotypes.
Analyzing AI-generated images of scientists for the disproportionate presence of Caucasian demographic features using the Draw-A-Scientist Checklist (DAST-C).
Scoring AI-generated images of scientists for the stereotypical presence of middle-aged or elderly features using the Draw-A-Scientist Checklist (DAST-C).
